definitions.gloss: neighboring house; the house next door
definitions.explanation: The house next to one's own. A written word; in speech people say {隣|となり}の{家|いえ} or just お{隣|となり}.

examples.japanese: {隣家|りんか}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出火|しゅっか}→出火：20260_shukka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A fire broke out in the house next door.
A tree in the neighbors' garden has grown over the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{隣家|りんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{燃|も}え{移|うつ}った⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The fire spread to the house next door as well, but luckily no one was hurt.

notes:
USAGE:
Typical of news reports (fires, disputes, accidents) and formal writing. Everyday speech uses ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧ or お⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧さん (the people next door).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隣家|りんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{燃|も}え{移|うつ}る: (a fire) to spread to the house next door
- {隣家|りんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住人|じゅうにん}→住人：11611_juunin⟧: the people living next door
